Max Evchenko

Front-end developer with many years of experience building modern web applications using Vue.js, Nuxt.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and other technologies to create high-quality user interfaces.

My projectsAbout me

MAIN DEVELOPMENT TOOLS

Getting started

My career began in television in the advertising department, where I worked as a designer of advertising products. At one point our agency needed a website, which started my journey into programming and web development. We built a site on WordPress and later added a website creation service for clients. That was just the beginning. I began studying web development and programming languages such as PHP, CSS and JavaScript. The more I learned, the more I realized that building sites on ready-made engines or with plain languages is not practical or flexible. It was necessary to learn frameworks; the first of them I studied was Laravel.

Vue.js and Front-End

When Vue.js was added to Laravel, I was excited by its capabilities and decided to switch to Front-End development. While learning Vue.js I also discovered Node.js and deepened my understanding of JavaScript and its new features. I became familiar with the web technologies listed in the Skills section by solving real tasks and gaining experience. They are described chronologically in the Work Experience

Nuxt.js

Over time I learned the Nuxt.js framework and realized it is the future of web development. I began using it in my projects. Nuxt.js allowed me to create more complex and scalable applications with less time and effort. I also started using TypeScript to improve code quality and reduce errors.

What's next?

I continue to study new technologies and tools in web development. Just like the Internet, which never stands still, I strive to keep up and improve. I apply all my skills and knowledge in my projects, which you can view in the Projects

What skills do I possess?

PRIMARY TOOLS

Vue.js

Progressive, open-source JavaScript framework for building user interfaces and single-page applications (SPA).

Nuxt.js

Open-source framework based on Vue.js that simplifies creating modern, high-performance, and SEO-friendly web applications.

Tailwind CSS

A utility-first CSS framework that enables rapid interface styling using small, reusable classes directly in HTML markup.

JavaScript

A versatile programming language that makes web pages interactive, allowing creation of dynamic content, animations, games, and DOM manipulation.

TypeScript

A superset of JavaScript that adds static typing and other features for building more reliable and scalable web applications.

GitHub

Web platform and hosting for software projects based on the Git version control system.

GitLab

A web application for managing Git repositories with CI/CD, monitoring, and project management features.

ADDITIONAL TOOLS

VueUse

A rich collection of ready-to-use utility functions (composables, e.g. useXyz) created for the Vue.js Composition API.

Nuxt UI

High-performance component library for the Nuxt.js framework, built on Vue 3 and Tailwind CSS.

Chart.js

Free, open-source JavaScript library for creating interactive and responsive charts and graphs in web applications.

Three.js

Open-source JavaScript library that simplifies creating and rendering animated 3D graphics directly in the browser.

Node.js

Cross-platform JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine.

Strapi

Free, open-source headless CMS written in Node.js that enables developers to create and manage content.

PHP

Open-source scripting language mainly used for building dynamic web pages and web applications.

I also have knowledge of languages such as C, C++, and C#, as well as various related technologies and libraries. I do not list them here because they are not part of my primary specialization, but I am ready to use them if necessary.
